5.title: Great!
5.body: I’m extremely pleased with these 3m pro comms. I daily drive a humvee soft top and it’s loud as hell and you can’t talk on the phone to anyone because they won’t hear you even with my Apple air pod plus. I bought these and honestly, I was skeptical at first, but when they arrived I immediately put in some AA batteries and went for a test ride. The caller on the other end of the line could not tell I was even driving my humvee. Crystal clear comms! So to take it a step further I drove all the way to my cabin on the phone the entire way. Arrived I cut off the humvee and jumped on my mower started it up and started mowing. They same caller on the line never even knew I transitioned from truck to mower and was able to talk while mowing my grass! I have a John Deere x475 with a 62” deck this thing is loud. So if you’re looking for a great clarity comms in a boom mic head set get these. You can legit mow your grass and talk on the phone all while protecting your hearing. I have an iPhone and pairing the Bluetooth was absolutely simple. I streamed music and even tested Netflix it all worked seamlessly. I prefer the AA better over charging that way when I go to put them on and they are dead I don’t have to wait to charge I can just swap out batteries. If your looking for something super slim line these are not for you but they are comfortable and I have a big ol head and they fit just fine. Ear pads are of nice quality as well. The boom mic is on left side which is fine for me but some may not like that I just wanted to clarify for you. Seem durable but haven’t tested them out long enough to be honest. Also, if you have an iPhone a hack to make all headphones with a mic better is to go into iPhone settings and turn on “voice isolation”. If your driving a open cab tractor, mower, or loud truck you will be happy with these. Soon to test out on the boat when driving at top speed.
